title: Self-Alignment of Large Language Models via Monopolylogue-based Social Scene Simulation
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning Large Language Models with 'human values' and 'societal norms.' It specifically aims to produce 'socially and ethically aligned responses' and evaluates the model's performance on safety and value-alignment benchmarks like HH-RLHF, PKU-SafeRLHF, and HarmfulQA.
